notes: All 31 source and 47 target IDs are partitioned exactly once.

The even of even all their sins goes to the appositional לְ standing on that very phrase: rule 16's added case governs an even before a phrase no morpheme marks, and here one does, on the reasoning that rule gives for a fronting לְ. The competing added reading is named in the unit note; contrast v. 32, where no morpheme stands and the even is correctly added.
מִן → because of is one compound rendering headed on because, the content word, and never on the connective (rule 24).
בְּתוֹךְ is split here (in the midst of) because the ASV writes three words, whereas v. 29 writes the single among and fuses — the difference is what the ASV wrote, as rule 30 requires.
